name: an-unknown-is-retried-on-an-effect-neuron-with-retry
description: On an effect neuron retry covers unknown: the crash at 10 is reported as the unknown it is, a retry note follows, and the second attempt's answer at 40 is the call's. Without retry the same crash is the call's outcome (effect/a-crashed-effect-call-is-unknown-and-commits-its-cost).
